title: 美银乔虹：6月PMI释放积极信号，政策会加码吗？
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: Well, I think generally this is good message.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为总体上是好消息。

segments.en: We're talking about the manufacturing sector, you know, doing a little bit better even on a sequential basis, but at the same time, I think the non-manufacturing side, the service side is also holding up pretty well.
segments.zh: 制造业环比有所改善，同时非制造业和服务业也表现稳健。

segments.en: So that, I think, lays a relatively constructive picture for June, and especially at the time when we're about to look at at least a second quarter and think about whether the policymakers are about to do something.
segments.zh: 这为6月勾勒了相对积极的图景，尤其是在我们即将审视二季度数据、思考政策制定者是否会有所动作的时候。

segments.en: Do you think it's soft enough to you think for them to do anything?
segments.zh: 您认为经济是否足够疲软，以至于他们会采取行动？
